summary: All four phases delivered their stated objectives and respected excluded scope. Phase-03 touched two unplanned telemetry test files as mechanical compile fixes required by the new required fields on GateFailedError and RunGatesWithFixLoopOptions; both are fully justified. No phase introduced scope creep. All boundary contracts were honoured across phase boundaries. The phase-01 commit subject could not be verified from available git history (only the five most recent commits were visible), but downstream consumption confirms the work landed correctly.

findings.message: Phase-01 commit subject could not be verified against the plan (planned: 'feat(gate): classify diagnostics and register a scopes provider') — the commit is outside the five most recent log entries visible to the reviewer. Downstream phase consumption confirms the work landed; a spot-check of git log is recommended.

Two unplanned test files were touched: tests/unit/telemetry/reportBuilders.test.ts (added pending: [] to a GateFailedError construction) and tests/integration/telemetry/adapterFailures.test.ts (added scheduling to a runGatesWithFixLoop options literal). Both are mechanical compile/runtime fixes caused by the new required fields; no behaviour change. Justified in the phase handoff.

PendingStep was placed in src/domain/errors.ts rather than src/app/gates.ts as the plan text implied, because domain events import from errors.ts and domain cannot import app. Architecturally correct and justified in the handoff.
